verdict.rationale: Ashby's own docs say the platform includes 'CRM & Sourcing' and covers recruiting 'from outreach to offer', and AI rediscovery surfaces existing candidates against job criteria. That confirms a first-party sourcing/CRM capability, but none of the story's specific elements are documented. missing for 10: documented prospect/talent pools, personalized email sequences, open/reply tracking, nurture campaigns for future roles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, sourcing lives in a talent CRM — pools of prospects, personalized email sequences with tracking, and nurture campaigns for future roles

citations.quote: Ashby's All-in-One Recruiting platform combines your ATS, Scheduling, CRM & Sourcing, and Analytics into one powerful tool.
The all-in-one recruiting product — from outreach to offer.
Use AI to scan your existing candidates, match them against job criteria, and surface key signals for rediscovery.
